fields.label: Messages
fields.description: An array of message objects representing the content of the memory. Each message object typically contains 'role' and 'content' fields, where 'role' indicates the sender either 'user' or 'assistant' and 'content' contains the actual message text. This structure allows for the representation of conversations or multi-part memories.

fields.label: Agent Id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the agent associated with this memory.

fields.label: User Id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the user associated with this memory.

fields.label: App Id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the application associated with this memory.

fields.label: Run Id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the run associated with this memory.

fields.label: Metadata
fields.description: Additional metadata associated with the memory, which can be used to store any additional information or context about the memory. Best practice for incorporating additional information is through metadata (e.g. location, time, ids, etc.). During retrieval, you can either use these metadata alongside the query to fetch relevant memories or retrieve memories based on the query first and then refine the results using metadata during post-processing.

fields.label: Includes
fields.description: String to include the specific preferences in the memory.

fields.label: Excludes
fields.description: String to exclude the specific preferences in the memory.

fields.label: Infer
fields.description: Whether to infer the memories or directly store the messages.

fields.label: Output Format
fields.description: Controls the response format structure. `v1.0` (deprecated) returns a direct array of memory objects: `[{...}, {...}]`. `v1.1` (recommended) returns an object with a 'results' key containing the array: `{"results": [...]}`. The `v1.0` format will be removed in future versions.

fields.label: Custom Categories
fields.description: A list of categories with category name and its description.

fields.label: Custom Instructions
fields.description: Defines project-specific guidelines for handling and organizing memories. When set at the project level, they apply to all new memories in that project.

fields.label: Async Mode
fields.description: Whether to add the memory completely asynchronously.

fields.label: Timestamp
fields.description: The timestamp of the memory. Format: Unix timestamp

fields.label: Expiration Date
fields.description: The date when the memory will expire. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

fields.label: Org Id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the organization associated with this memory.

fields.label: Project Id
fields.description: The unique identifier of the project associated with this memory.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: The version of the memory to use. The default version is v1, which is deprecated. We recommend using v2 for new applications.
